selection.decision_rule: Only after raw-source authentication and full F124-M archive and two untested GenEnv plus two untested Promptbreeder candidates in EACH lane, F124-N negative relative to the 12-of-16 control in BOTH lanes selects the first structurally distinct path-preserving multi-route key-compatibility candidate. No outcome-dependent switching. Historical Pareto finalist is NOT an independently accepted scientific winner.
selection.representation: Per-path raw 16-bit transported key; retain multiple rival hypotheses and their soft match energies rather than collapsing to original Arm B scalar/signed 21-parameter evidence.
selection.consumer: Causal role/topology-constrained propagation of competing path energies with learned soft bit-compatibility scale and learned terminal calibration; no exact edge-match gate, labels, reference path, oracle or reserved facts in predictor.
selection.environment: Reuse precisely frozen F124-N source's FIT and DEV as DEVELOPMENT cohorts; DEV has already been observed in F124-N and must NOT be described as fresh protected first-use. Distinct independent unseen source required for later science.
null_controls: exact symbolic reference ceiling, ineligible for algorithmic gains
selection.non_eligibility: No automatic candidate approval, policy improvement claim or scientific dispatch from Pareto/GenEnv/Promptbreeder advisory outputs.

training.score: Path log energy = log(sigmoid((bit_match_count - 12) * scale / 4)), aggregated by log-sum-exp over surviving target paths, plus learned bias. Cross-entropy on FIT positive/negative pairs only.
training.frozen_training_stop: 28 epochs, no early stop, no test-set tuning, no hyperparameter search
training.success_rule: Report exact paired DEV score and comparison to each frozen control; count errors as failures, retain all negatives. Stronger development superiority only when paired DEV > fixed 12-of-16 in BOTH lanes, and explicitly note unmatched operations; protected scientific superiority never implied.
